title: Suppression of hemp russet mite, Aculops cannabicola (Acari: Eriophyidae), in industrial hemp in greenhouse and field
notes: Hemp-specific efficacy study under defined greenhouse and field conditions. Useful for demonstrating treatment-response evidence and context dependence. It must not be converted into product recommendations without current registration, crop/site label, worker-safety, residue, jurisdiction and facility authorization review.
